summary: UI/UX validation of /launch-presentation deck (mass-audience version, Iter 131e). All 8 slides load and animate. Cover slide renders MPCA emblem + 'MADHYA PRADESH CRICKET ASSOCIATION' overline + 'Welcome.' 132px headline + gold tagline + SEASON 2026 - 27 badge, all centered on a full-bleed emerald gradient. Arrow nav, keyboard nav (ArrowLeft/Right, Space, digits 1-8), and progress bar (12.5% -> 100%) all work. No small-font (<16px) text detected inside any slide's content surface (all 8 slides). Screenshot slides render large product screenshots (>900px tall) with no caption text. No horizontal or vertical overflow at 1920x1080 or 1366x768. Prev disabled on slide 1, Next disabled on slide 8. No console errors/warnings.
critical_code_review_comments: Exit link (/dashboard) requires auth; anonymous auditorium click bounces to /login. Not a bug per spec ('deck route is public'), but worth noting for demo-day - if presenter isn't logged in, clicking the X exits to /login rather than /dashboard. This matches Exit href='/dashboard' behavior as designed.

Hidden counter span (display:none) still exists in DOM (data-testid=launch-counter) - fine for a11y hint but the aria-label lives on a display:none element so screen-readers may skip it. Consider aria-live region if a11y matters.
SLIDES array uses inline render fns - fine for 8 slides, no perf concern.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Deck at /launch-presentation is public. Test at 1920x1080 and 1366x768. Verified: cover-slide, cover-emblem, cover-association, cover-welcome ('Welcome.'), cover-tagline, cover-season, launch-next, launch-prev, launch-progress, launch-exit, screenshot-img on slides 3/5/7. Keyboard: 1-8 jump, ArrowRight/Space advance, ArrowLeft back. All screenshots (public_reg_docs_first.png, player_ai_flagged.png, schemes_division.png) load from /deck-screenshots/. No small-font content in any slide.
